title: Recurrent Amplification and Exact Nonexpansiveness Criteria for Query-Driven Erasure
abstract: arXiv:2611.27109v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Query-derived Erase Direction (QED) augments a rank-one linear attention update with a key-orthogonal query component. Under scalar decay, this correction leaves the eigenvalues of each homogeneous state transition unchanged, while the propagation of an initial perturbation depends on the ordered product of these transitions. We construct a periodic token sequence with fixed key and query projections for which every one-step spectral radius is below one but the spectral radius of the period product exceeds one. The same construction yields a sufficient condition for mean-square growth under independent uniform token sampling. For rank-one erasure with channel-wise decay, we derive a necessary and sufficient spectral-norm test for one-step nonexpansiveness that can be evaluated in $O(d)$ time. The test agrees with direct singular value decomposition on all 1,800 operators evaluated. In a counterfactual replay of a selected head of Qwe

translated_title: 查询驱动擦除中的循环放大与精确非扩张性判据
translated_abstract: 查询衍生擦除方向在秩一线性注意力更新的基础上引入了一个与键正交的查询分量。在标量衰减下，这一修正不改变每个齐次状态转移的特征值，而初始扰动的传播则取决于这些转移的有序乘积。我们构造了一个具有固定键投影和查询投影的周期性词元序列，其中每一步转移的谱半径都小于一，但整个周期乘积的谱半径却大于一。同一构造还给出了在独立均匀词元采样下均方增长的充分条件。对于带逐通道衰减的秩一擦除，我们推导出了一个一步非扩张性的充分必要谱范数判据，该判据可在 O(d) 时间内完成计算。在全部 1,800 个被评估的算子上，该判据与直接奇异值分解的结果完全一致。在对选定的某个注意力头的反事实重放中……
tldr: 该论文的核心贡献是构造了单步收缩但周期乘积却产生放大的周期词元序列，证明查询驱动的擦除机制可引发循环放大，并首次给出了可在 O(d) 时间内计算的秩一擦除一步非扩张性的充要谱范数判据。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs periodic token sequences that are contractive at every step yet amplifying over the full period, demonstrating recurrent amplification in query-driven erasure, and derives an exact necessary-and-sufficient spectral-norm test for one-step nonexpansiveness of rank-one erasure computable in O(d) time.
